newsitem.title: PERU: Bus crash in Peruvian Andes kills nine - agency.
newsitem.headline: Bus crash in Peruvian Andes kills nine - agency.

text.p: LIMA, Jan 12 - A bus careened off a mountain highway and plunged 100 yards (meters) down a ravine in the Peruvian Andes, killing nine people and injuring 26 more, state news agency Andina reported on Sunday.

The bus -- packed with about 40 passengers -- overshot a corner in early on Saturday as it snaked though the highland village of Sibayo, near the city of Arequipa, 625 miles (1,000 km) south of the capital Lima, the agency said.
Officials at Arequipa's main hospital said they had discharged most of the injured but eight more were in serious condition.
Road acidents are frequent in the Peruvian Andes, where most people travel along poorly maintained roads on overloaded buses.
